metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent filled B3:B30 and D3:D30 with acceleration formulas and created a new combined column from all columns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can fill formula ranges and create derived numeric columns using arithmetic.
metadata.task_rationale: Replaces the concatenation column with a physics-relevant column: E = B - D (acceleration difference between up and down ramp). Tests formula fill plus derived column creation.
metadata.explanation: Evaluator checks: (1) E1 contains 'diff' (case-insensitive) -> 0.20, (2) E2~2.957 (B2-D2 = -2.24047-(-5.19723), tolerance 0.02) -> 0.20, (3) E30~2.92 (B30-D30, tolerance 0.02) -> 0.20, (4) B30~1.70 -> 0.20, (5) D30~-1.22 (column D filled, tolerance 0.02) -> 0.20. [Fixed: E2 expected value corrected from -7.44 (B2+D2 sum, wrong) to 2.957 (B2-D2 difference, correct); added D30 check for direct column D verification; redistributed weights from 0.25 to 0.20 each; renamed function suffix from invalid 8-char '104128c1' to valid 32-char MD5 'e64652ba3bf9a74b525e231bf3f391d2']

llm_judge_reasons: All three previous critical issues identified by the prior judge have been fixed: (1) E2 expected value corrected from -7.44 (B2+D2 sum) to 2.957 (correct B2-D2 difference), (2) D30 check added for direct column D fill verification, (3) weights redistributed to 0.20x5.
E1 header check ('diff' case-insensitive) correctly verifies column E is named 'Accel Difference' as required by the instruction.
E2 check (abs(e2 - 2.957) <= 0.02) correctly verifies E=B-D: -2.24047-(-5.19723)=2.95676, well within tolerance.
E30 check (~2.92) is consistent with B30≈1.70 and D30≈-1.22, giving B30-D30=2.92. Correct.
B30 check (~1.70) verifies column B (rows 3-30) was filled using the row 2 formula.
D30 check (~-1.22) directly verifies column D (rows 3-30) was filled using the row 2 formula.
Getter uses openpyxl data_only=True; postconfig saves file with Ctrl+S first, ensuring cached values are populated. This is the correct pattern for xlsx verification.
All task requirements are covered: (1) B3:B30 filled, (2) D3:D30 filled, (3) column E named with 'Diff' showing B-D values. Partial credit scoring distributes weight evenly across all five checks.
